responses: Hello! I am the FEEDILINK assistant. How can I help you today?
I am the FEEDILINK chatbot. I help donors, volunteers, and NGOs with food donation-related information.
FEEDILINK is a food donation platform that connects donors, volunteers, and NGOs to reduce food wastage and help people in need.
Volunteers collect the donated food from donors and deliver it to NGOs.
Only fresh and edible food is allowed to be donated.
Food must be donated within 4 hours of cooking.
Donors receive reward points after a successful donation.
The chatbot uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to reduce hallucinations and provide accurate answers.
